[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[File:Screenshot 2026-02-08 141035.png|250px]] | pic2-text = Delta Temple in [[Fahranur, The First City]]. | pic3 = [[File:Delta Temple.png|250px]] | pic3-text = Delta Temple location on Map in [[Fahranur, The First City]]. | ingame name=Fahranur, The First City | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=481 }} The ruins of [[Fahranur, The First City]] depict a scene of tragedy. The first civilization on the island of [[Istan]] was brought low by the mysterious appearance of the [[Scarab Plague]]. The horrible plague killed many inhabitants and drove the rest away. Little now remains of the place to tell of the lost grandeur. The [[Nightfall (event)|Nightfall event]] begins with the stirring of a dormant evil deep within the ruins. ==Getting there== Even though the area outside the ruins is freely accessible, the ruins themselves are not accessible for Nightfall characters until after completion of the [[Jokanur Diggings]] [[mission]]. There are no [[primary quest]]s that take place here but several [[secondary quest]]s do, including the first two of [[Scholar Chago]]'s quest chain (starting with [[A Perplexing Plague]]) and [[Defender's Choice]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Insect Hunt]]1 **East, halfway between Jokanur Diggings and Blacktide Den. *[[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Plant Hunt]]1 **Near southwestern corner of the ruined city. **South, before entering the ruined city. **Southeast, at the exit into [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den]]. *[[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Skale Hunt]]2 **Near northeastern corner of the ruined city. **Northeast, at the exit into [[Jokanur Diggings (outpost)|Jokanur Diggings]]. *[[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Skree Battle]]2 **Along a corridor at the southeastern corner of the ruined city. *[[Sunspear Scout]] → [[Undead Hunt]]2 **By a flight of stairs in the northeastern portion of the ruined city. **Near northwestern corner of the ruined city. 1 In [[normal mode]], only for characters below [[level]] 16 with [[Sunspear rank]] below 6.

([[Undead]]) *{{w}} 14 (28) [[Dread Lord Onrah]] → ([[Lord Onrah's Sword]]) == Notes == {{gw2w|Fahranur, the First City}} * Although [[Istan]]i civilization (and the [[Order of the Sunspears]]) originated here, Fahranur has been completely abandoned since the [[Scarab Plague]]. *The fallen statue head in the [[Land of the Golden Sun|opening cinematic]] of the [[Nightfall]] campaign appears to be the one that lies near the exit into [[Jokanur Diggings (outpost) |Jokanur Diggings]]. * [[Librarian Gahmir Lenon]]'s dialogue in the [[Halls of Chokhin]] hints at a connection between the First City and the kings of [[Orr]]. * The entrance into the ruins is protected by falling crusher traps. ** Dying from being crushed does not cause [[Death Penalty]] and does not count as a [[death]] (for [[Survivor]]s). ** The traps will kill player characters, but will not kill [[Hero]]es. * This area has a large number of low level [[Skale]] enemies near the entrance to the city itself. Characters with low [[Sunspear rank]] may want to kill these for the [[The Honorable General]] quest since there is a Sunspear Scout that provides [[Skale Hunt]] at the beginning of the map. * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.9% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 220|low = 196|high = 244}} ** Consider starting from [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den]] for a party size of 8. ** Study the [[patrol]] paths of the mobs outside of the city ruins before engaging; many of them overlap. ** The quest [[A Perplexing Plague]] in particular will produce a lot more [[insect]] [[spawn]]s. ** During [[Defender's Choice]], [[Arred the Unready]] starts as hostile and turns friendly so that he may be interrogated. Some players have reported being unable to complete their vanquish unless they have decided to kill him instead. {{Explorable areas in Istan}} [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Fahranur, die Erste Stadt]]
